web:transformer-circuits.pub/2024/scalin.gist: Sparse autoencoders scale to Claude 3 Sonnet, finding millions of interpretable features.
web:transformer-circuits.pub/2024/scalin.note: Math 2: features as directions and an L1-penalised reconstruction loss carry the main line; no matrix manipulation needed. ~22k words with many figures.

arxiv:2209.10652.gist: Toy networks store more features than dimensions by superposition, with phase changes.
arxiv:2209.10652.note: Empirical: toy-model experiments are the evidence, the analysis supports them (formal 1). Classic: interpretability reading lists start here.

arxiv:2212.08073.gist: Train harmless assistants from written principles and AI feedback, not human labels.
arxiv:2212.08073.note: Method: proposes a training procedure and evaluates it. Safety training is primary; general post-training secondary. Main body ~9.5k words of 34 pages.

pdf:nickbostrom.com/papers/vulnerable.pd.gist: Some technologies may make devastation the default without unprecedented global governance.
pdf:nickbostrom.com/papers/vulnerable.pd.note: Not AI-specific, so the general catastrophic-risk home is primary. A journal-form argument is a position paper, not an essay; historical cases are illustrations (empirical 0).

lw:7im8at9PmhbT4JHsW.gist: Yudkowsky argues to Ngo why aligning powerful AI is so hard.
lw:7im8at9PmhbT4JHsW.note: Dialogue transcripts count as essays. Audience enthusiast: it assumes years of community context rather than formal training.

pdf:storage.googleapis.com/deepmind-medi.gist: DeepMind's first framework: capability thresholds triggering security and deployment mitigations.
pdf:storage.googleapis.com/deepmind-medi.note: Policy: a lab laying down its own protocols. Era goes by date (2024), even though versions 2 and 3 supersede it.

arxiv:2102.05008.gist: Adds subgame-perfect and trembling-hand equilibria to multi-agent influence diagrams.
arxiv:2102.05008.note: Proofs fill an 8-page appendix, but theorem-proof is the structure (formal 2). Code 1: a short demo of the pycid library. Main body ~8k words at 60 wpm.

arxiv:2404.15255.gist: Practical guide to running and interpreting activation patching experiments.
arxiv:2404.15255.note: Tutorial written for working researchers, so explainer with audience researcher. Math 2: logit differences, probabilities, KL as metrics.

arxiv:2605.15257.gist: Finetuning on documents about CoT monitors makes models evade them more.
arxiv:2605.15257.note: Frontier: May 2026, on an open question. Main body 11 of 59 pages (~6.4k words).

pdf:mason.gmu.edu/~rhanson/futarchy.pdf.gist: Futarchy: vote on welfare measures, let speculative markets choose policies.
pdf:mason.gmu.edu/~rhanson/futarchy.pdf.note: A paper proposing an institution: position genre, stance proposes. Classic: the founding statement of futarchy.

eaf:sMjcjnnpoAQCcedL2.gist: Pool forecasts with the geometric mean of odds, not averaged probabilities.
eaf:sMjcjnnpoAQCcedL2.note: A forum post arguing a recommendation from cited studies: essay, argues, empirical 1 (cited, not original, data).

lw:dHchoTG6tRGEDHbtj.gist: A thousand personal predictions: well calibrated, except about her own behaviour.
lw:dHchoTG6tRGEDHbtj.note: Original data analysed, so empirical 2 even in a short blog post: genre follows content, not venue.

lw:wE7SK8w8AixqknArs.gist: A rule-of-succession variant based on elapsed time rather than trial counts.
lw:wE7SK8w8AixqknArs.note: A post whose contribution is a derivation: genre theory, formal 1 (derivations, no theorem-proof). Worked examples give empirical 1.

eaf:TfPdb2aMKzgWXFvc3.gist: Squiggle, a programming language for probabilistic estimates, opens for public use.
eaf:TfPdb2aMKzgWXFvc3.note: Announcement genre wins over explainer. Code 2: Squiggle code examples carry the post.

web:delegation-risk.quantifieduncertaint.gist: Treat AI delegation risk as expected loss; budget it and price correlation.
web:delegation-risk.quantifieduncertaint.note: Undated QURI wiki pages are current (2025-26) work on an open problem: frontier. Tech 3: agent-security terms (prompt injection, MCP) used freely.

web:delegation-risk.quantifieduncertaint.gist: Formulas, harm-mode checklist and pattern pointers for the Delegation Risk framework.
web:delegation-risk.quantifieduncertaint.note: A lookup page: reference genre, stance records. Tech 4 because it assumes the framework it summarises.

web:evaluation-engineering.quantifiedunc.gist: How to measure an evaluator's reliability, validity, calibration and gaming resistance.
web:evaluation-engineering.quantifiedunc.note: Epistemics primary (evaluating evaluators); statistics and LLM judges secondary. Math 3: chance-corrected agreement, error bars, sample sizes, prediction-powered inference.

web:reasoning-processes.quantifieduncert.gist: Oversight protocols differ by what grounds their incentives; none dominates, so compose.
web:reasoning-processes.quantifieduncert.note: Survey genre with stance argues: it maps the protocols but defends a thesis. Stance is independent of genre.

web:priors.quantifieduncertainty.org/cul.gist: Everyday cooperation as status games; much of morality is really coordination.
web:priors.quantifieduncertainty.org/cul.note: Rough bullet-note draft (March 2025): essay. Dated by writing, so recent.

arxiv:1706.03762.gist: Introduces the Transformer: sequence modelling with attention alone, no recurrence.
arxiv:1706.03762.note: A repository link alone is not code (code 0). Main body ~4.4k words of 15 pages.

arxiv:2310.06770.gist: Benchmark of real GitHub issues testing whether models can write fixes.
arxiv:2310.06770.note: Benchmark beats empirical when the dataset is the contribution. Tech 3: a software engineer can follow it. Main body 10 of 52 pages.

arxiv:2303.08774.gist: OpenAI's GPT-4 capabilities, predictable scaling and safety work, few architecture details.
arxiv:2303.08774.note: Main body is the 14-page report; the attached 60-page system card counts as an appendix for mins.

arxiv:2001.08361.gist: Language-model loss falls as power laws in parameters, data and compute.
arxiv:2001.08361.note: Math 2: power laws and log-log fits carry the main line; the compute-allocation derivations are secondary (formal 1). Main body pp. 1-19.

lw:wCqfCLs8z5Qw4GbKS.gist: Big improvements need admitting big mistakes, not just small local errors.
lw:wCqfCLs8z5Qw4GbKS.note: A famous Sequences post but not field-founding: established, not classic. The Enron story is an illustration (empirical 0).

lw:JH6tJhYpnoCfFqAct.gist: Dark satire of an AI-company engineer's complicity as AI takes control.
lw:JH6tJhYpnoCfFqAct.note: Fiction: field is the subject satirised; literature is secondary. Fiction is never frontier.

lw:gTZ2SxesbHckJ3CkF.gist: Transformers' residual streams linearly encode belief-state geometry, including predicted fractals.
lw:gTZ2SxesbHckJ3CkF.note: A LessWrong post reporting experiments is empirical, not essay.

lw:zHhGa3iQBQcdSifFL.gist: Lean 4 lacks a consistency proof and has soundness bugs; trust cautiously.
lw:zHhGa3iQBQcdSifFL.note: Concepts from logic are discussed, not worked through: math 2. Kernel bug reports are cited evidence (empirical 1). October 2026: frontier.

bstj:27-3-379.gist: Founds information theory: entropy, channel capacity and the coding theorems.
bstj:27-3-379.note: Judge tech for a reader today: Shannon is unusually clear (tech 3). Theorem-proof structure (formal 2) slows pace one step. ~44 BSTJ pages at ~450 words.

book:mackay-itila.gist: Textbook uniting information theory, coding, Bayesian inference and neural networks.
book:mackay-itila.note: A broad book gets a shorter path: use the deepest level that covers most of it. 640 pages, ~280k words.

book:gray-entropy-it.gist: Rigorous measure-theoretic treatment of entropy and coding theorems for general sources.
book:gray-entropy-it.note: Math 5 anchor: proof-dense, measure-theoretic throughout. 324 pages.

book:ashby-intro-cybernetics.gist: Introductory cybernetics: machines, regulation and the law of requisite variety.
book:ashby-intro-cybernetics.note: Math 2 although it reaches Markov chains: Ashby builds everything from elementary algebra, for biologists.

wikisource:maxwell-on-governors.gist: First mathematical stability analysis of governors, founding feedback control theory.
wikisource:maxwell-on-governors.note: For a reader today the maths is undergraduate ODE stability (math 3); archaic notation and machinery raise tech to 4.

ttrpg:lasers-feelings.gist: One-page sci-fi RPG with a single stat: Lasers versus Feelings.
ttrpg:lasers-feelings.note: Mins counts reading the rules, not playing. Dice pools are math 1.

ia:reisswitz-1824.gist: The original Prussian Kriegsspiel rules for map-based military manoeuvre simulation.
ia:reisswitz-1824.note: Audience is who it was written for (officers). Classic: the origin of wargaming and refereed play. Mins assume a fluent reader of the language.

ia:investigationofl00boolrich.gist: Founds an algebra of logic and applies it to probability.
ia:investigationofl00boolrich.note: Classic even though superseded: landmarks stay classic; historical is for ordinary period pieces. ~424 text pages.

ia:WesternUnionTelegraphicCode.gist: Commercial code book: codewords standing for whole phrases to cut telegraph costs.
ia:WesternUnionTelegraphicCode.note: Tables and code lists: 1 minute per page. The code flag means program code, so 0. Commercial codes are not secret ciphers.

ia:mathematicalrecr1920ball.gist: Classic collection of mathematical puzzles, games and recreational essays.
ia:mathematicalrecr1920ball.note: Puzzles genre (problems are the substance). Classic of recreational mathematics, revised for a century.

ia:picksliderule00pickrich.gist: Practical manual for calculating with the slide rule, with worked examples.
ia:picksliderule00pickrich.note: An ordinary period manual: historical. ~120 text pages at ~300 words.

ia:britishchessmag03unkngoog.gist: A year of a Victorian chess monthly: games, problems, news and analysis.
ia:britishchessmag03unkngoog.note: Game records are not empirical data in this scheme. Tech 3: annotated games need a board and notation.

ia:worksofarchimede00arch.gist: Heath's English edition of Archimedes' geometry and mechanics, with long introduction.
ia:worksofarchimede00arch.note: Collected works plus an editor's 186-page introduction. Greek proofs throughout: formal 2. The IA shelf says "mechanics", but most of it is geometry.
